newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Bandits free UN refugee official kidnapped in Mali.
newsitem.headline: Bandits free UN refugee official kidnapped in Mali.

text.p: Bandits in Mali abandoned a United Nations refugee agency official in a remote desert three days after kidnapping him from his home and stealing his car and cash, a UNHCR spokesman said on Thursday.
The official, who was abducted in the northeastern town of Kidal by two unidentified attackers on Sunday, was found by nomads in the desert on Wednesday night.

It was the second time Martin Bucumi, 41, a Burundian who was head of the U.N. High Commissioner for Refugees office in Kidal, was kidnapped by bandits in six months in the West African country, the spokesman said.
